Workshop status: D

United States (reported) submitted B=3, D=2, F=1. Russian Federation (verified) submitted B=1, D=3.

Package D is decisive with a lower grade of 2 versus B's 1, though one card remains unverified.

The workshop has no official authority. S/2019/186: It received nine votes in favour, three against and three abstentions.
